title: pop(index) leaves stale indices in map, so index() returns wrong values
property: after pop(i), index(x) equals the position of x in the set's iteration order
expected: 0, since the set is now OrderedSet([1])
evidence: index() docstring: 'Get the index of a given entry'; add() returns the item's index. discard() renumbers map after removal, but pop() only deletes the entry and never adjusts later indices. Popping a non-last element is allowed by the documented 'Remove and return item at index'.

title: symmetric_difference_update adds duplicates when other contains repeated items
property: the set stays duplicate-free and matches symmetric_difference(other)
actual: items == [0, 0] while map has one key, so the set holds a duplicate and len is 2
evidence: other is typed SetLike[T], which accepts lists; symmetric_difference handles it correctly and an OrderedSet must contain unique items. items_to_add is built without de-duplicating.
